correctness.rationale: The feed-forward Jacobian is block lower triangular. Each zero-biomass block is triangular; for positive first-reactor blocks det>0 forces a negative trace, and for positive second-reactor blocks the equilibrium biomass balance gives tr=q-D-delta and det=D(delta-alpha q), so det>0 forces tr<0 and trace zero forces det<0.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly leaves the relevant trace sign and possible Hopf bifurcation open. Exact-title/identifier, serial-AM2, trace-determinant, Hopf/limit-cycle, and related chemostat searches found no prior statement of this no-Hopf theorem or trace-condition redundancy; standard block-triangular and 2x2 criteria are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the Hopf part of a stated open problem, simplifies the local stability criteria for the source model, and resolves the trace-indeterminate multiple-root coexistence cases by a reusable equilibrium-flux obstruction.
